text: A heavy diamond-tier pick that clears a **3 by 3** plane in one swing, paid for in Pulse. Tunnels and quarries go three times faster.

pages.title: Swinging it
text: Hold it in your main hand and crouch-use a block face. The maul breaks the 3 by 3 plane around that block, square to the face you hit.
Each block costs **8 Pulse** from a Pulse Cell you carry. If Pulse runs out mid-swing, the remaining blocks stay. After a swing that breaks anything, the maul rests **one second**.
It only takes what a pickaxe could, and only what its diamond tier can harvest. Normal player block protection still applies.
Swung without crouching, it is an ordinary pickaxe.
A totem-bound Earth pick opens 3 by 3 the same way; see [Totem-bound gear](totem_bound_gear).
